import ctypes

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# gsl_rng_types_setup returns a pointer to an array of pointers to gsl_rng_type
# We assume that the array ends with a NULL pointer

# Define a pointer type for gsl_rng_type
class gsl_rng_type(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

# Define the function prototype
# The function returns a pointer to an array of pointers to gsl_rng_type
# We assume that the array ends with a NULL pointer
gsl.gsl_rng_types_setup.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rng_type))

# Call the function
def get_rng_types():
    rng_types_ptr = gsl.gsl_rng_types_setup()
    rng_types = []
    i = 0
    while rng_types_ptr[i]:
        rng_types.append(rng_types_ptr[i])
        i += 1
    return rng_types

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    rng_types = get_rng_types()
    assert len(rng_types) > 0, "The list of RNG types should not be empty."
    assert isinstance(rng_types[0], ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rng_type)), "The elements should be pointers to gsl_rng_type."
